title: Home Away From Home (5 miles to downtown)
description:
Relax on the open, covered porch, walk to your favorite shops, and come home to a modern, spacious living space to enjoy a gourmet meal with your friends and family.  We are pet friendly (some rules apply).    Glorious porch, huge yard, fire pit, plenty of parking and walkable to the best shopping! Minutes to downtown.

The space
Home is a Duplex.  Owner lives in attached separate apartment with dedicated entrance.  Guests stay in the main house which they have completely to themselves. There is one shared wall between the two living spaces. The entire grounds, deck and porch are designated for the guest use/enjoyment. The parking pad in front (2-3 cars) and two additional spots in the back will be for guests.  Guests will have main house access through front and back doors as shown in the photos

Other things to note
the owner lives adjacent to the property.
